title: APTIS SPEAKING: CÁCH NÂNG BAND LÊN B2/C
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / APTIS SPEAKING: CÁCH NÂNG BAND LÊN B2/C

APTIS SPEAKING: CÁCH NÂNG BAND LÊN B2/C

Cập nhật lúc 17:58 - 15/08/2026

APTIS SPEAKING: CÁCH NÂNG BAND LÊN B2/C

Youtube : Speaking 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=cuoT5IgTZDSHBQfd&v=q7EJQ_Prnjk&feature=youtu.be

 

Theo thang đánh giá của British Council, 5 tiêu chí đánh giá Speaking

1. Task fulfilment / Topic relevance – Trả lời đúng chủ đề, đủ nội dung.

2. Grammatical range and accuracy – Độ đa dạng và chính xác của ngữ pháp.

3. Vocabulary range and accuracy – Vốn từ và độ phù hợp.

4. Pronunciation – Phát âm rõ, dễ hiểu.

5. Fluency and coherence – Độ trôi chảy, mạch lạc khi nói.

 

1. TỪ B1 → B2/C: CẦN THAY ĐỔI GÌ?

Nguyên tắc chung:

• B1 → B2: Nói đúng → Nói đủ → Giải thích → Phát triển

• B2 → C1: Nói đủ → Nói sâu → Linh hoạt → Chính xác → Tự nhiên

 

2. Cách phát triển câu trả lời

 

3. Liên từ & từ nối thường dùng

 

Nêu quan điểm

Nguyên nhân – kết quả

So sánh – đối lập

 

4. Cấu trúc ngữ pháp nên thuộc để nâng band

 

1. It allows me to + V (điều đó cho phép tôi…) 

It allows me to learn new things and gain useful knowledge.

Nó cho phép tôi học những điều mới và có thêm kiến thức hữu ích.

2. Not only… but also…  (không những… mà còn…)

Exercise not only improves physical health but also reduces stress.

Tập thể dục không những cải thiện sức khỏe thể chất mà còn giảm căng thẳng.

3. If…, … would…  (câu điều kiện: nếu… thì… sẽ…)

If more people used public transport, cities would have less traffic congestion.

Nếu nhiều người sử dụng phương tiện công cộng hơn, các thành phố sẽ bớt tắc nghẽn giao thông.

4. …, which…  (mệnh đề quan hệ bổ sung: …, điều mà…)

Online learning gives students greater flexibility, which allows them to study at their own pace.

Học trực tuyến mang lại sự linh hoạt hơn cho học sinh, điều này cho phép các em học theo tốc độ riêng.

5. While it is true that…, I would argue that…  (đúng là… nhưng tôi cho rằng…)

While it is true that city life is convenient, I would argue that the countryside offers a healthier environment.

Đúng là cuộc sống thành phố tiện lợi, nhưng tôi cho rằng vùng nông thôn mang lại môi trường sống lành mạnh hơn.

6. One reason is that… Another reason is that…  (một lý do là… một lý do khác là…)

One reason is that it is convenient. Another reason is that it is affordable.

Một lý do là nó tiện lợi. Một lý do khác là nó có giá cả phải chăng.

7. The reason why… is that…  (lý do vì sao… là vì…)

The reason why I like football is that it helps me stay fit.

Lý do tôi thích bóng đá là vì nó giúp tôi giữ dáng.

8. By + V-ing  (bằng cách…)

I improve my English by watching videos.

Tôi cải thiện tiếng Anh bằng cách xem video.

 

5.  TỪ VỰNG NÂNG CAO (BAND B2/C1)

Từ vựng đa dạng hơn, dùng collocations và diễn đạt tinh tế hơn.

 

Cảm xúc / Tinh thần

Kiến thức & giáo dục

 

 

Mối quan hệ

Sức khỏe

Kinh tế

Văn hóa

 

6. Ghi nhớ

Không cần cố dùng từ thật khó. 

Hãy ưu tiên từ vựng đúng ngữ cảnh + collocations tự nhiên + cấu trúc đa dạng + phát triển ý rõ ràng - đó là con đường ngắn nhất để lên band B2/C1 trong Aptis Speaking.

title: Các thủ tục đăng kí thi và tính điểm bài thi
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Các thủ tục đăng kí thi và tính điểm bài...

Các thủ tục đăng kí thi và tính điểm bài thi

Cập nhật lúc 02:10 - 04/10/2026

Các câu hỏi thường gặp về kỳ thi Aptis

1. Đăng ký thi Aptis

Q1: Đăng ký thi Aptis ở
A: Bạn đăng ký trực tuyến trên website : https://aptistests.vn/dang-ky-thong-tin

 

 Q2: Cần giấy tờ gì khi đăng ký thi?
A: Bạn cần CCCD hoặc hộ chiếu còn hạn và email cá nhân để nhận thông tin xác nhận.

 

Q3: Có những dạng chứng chỉ Aptis nào?

- Aptis General: Dành cho mục đích học tập và công việc cơ bản.

- Aptis Advanced: Dành cho mục đích học tập chuyên sâu, nghiên cứu và công việc yêu cầu trình độ cao.

- Xét chuẩn đầu vào, đầu ra của các trường đại học, cao học chọn Aptis general.

 

Q4: Chọn địa điểm thi nào?

A: Chọn địa điểm nào trong các lựa chọn đều được.

 

Q5: Lệ phí thi Aptis là bao nhiêu?
A: Aptis general lệ phí thi là 2 triệu. Chuyển khoản cho Hội đồng Anh trong vòng 24h kể từ khi đăng ký thi.

 

Q6: Làm sao biết đã đăng ký thành công?

- Sẽ có email hướng dẫn thanh toán sau khi đăng ký thi và email xác nhận đăng ký thành công sau khi thanh toán lệ phí thi.

 

📅 2. Lịch thi và đổi lịch

Q7: Làm sao biết lịch thi Aptis gần nhất?
A: Lịch thi được đăng công khai trên website. Bạn có thể chọn ngày thi và địa điểm phù hợp khi đăng ký online.

- Aptis hiện được tổ chức gần như tất cả các ngày trong tuần với 3 ca thi sáng, chiều và tối.

 

Q8: Có được huỷ/ đổi lịch thi không?

A: Có thể, nhưng bạn phải thông báo trước và có lý do chính đáng. Phí đổi lịch có thể được áp dụng.

 Xem mục hỏi đáp trên website : https://aptistests.vn/hoi-dap

 

💻 3. Trong ngày thi

 

Q9: Khi nào cần đến địa điểm thi?

- Đến địa điểm thi trước thời gian quy định, bạn sẽ nhận được email thông báo cụ thể 3-5 ngày trước khi thi.

 

Q10: Cần mang gì khi đi thi?
A: Mang CCCD hoặc hộ chiếu bản gốc

Quy định về giấy tờ tùy thân của thí sinh thi Aptis ESOL 

 

Q11: Thi Aptis trên máy hay trên giấy?
A: Thi trên máy tính tại địa điểm thi.

 

Q12. Có được phát bút và giấy nháp khi thi không

A: Có, nháp sẽ thu lại sau khi kết thúc bài thi.

 

Q13: Có tủ đựng đồ tại địa điểm thi không?

A: Có

 

📊 4. Cấu trúc và cách tính điểm

 

Q14: Aptis có mấy phần thi?
A: Gồm 4 kỹ năng: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking, và 1 phần Grammar & Vocabulary (không tính vào tổng band điểm).

 

Q15: Cách tính điểm mỗi kỹ năng như thế nào?
A: Điểm tối đa mỗi kỹ năng là 50 điểm và quy đổi ra thang điểm CEFR (A1 – C1).

Reading: 4 parts - 29 câu. Máy tính chấm.

Part 1: 10 điểm (5 câu)

Part 2: 10 điểm (2.1: 5 điểm + 2.2: 5 điểm)

Part 3: 16 điểm (7 câu – 4 người - mỗi người 4 điểm)

Part 4: 14 điểm (7 câu)

Listening: 4 parts - 25 câu - mỗi câu 2 điểm. Máy tính chấm.

Part 1: 13 câu = 26 điểm

Part 2: câu 14, trong câu này có 4 câu nhỏ = 8 điểm

Part 3: câu 15, trong câu này có 4 câu nhỏ = 8 điểm

Part 4: câu 16 & câu 17, mỗi câu chứa 2 câu nhỏ = 8 điểm

Writing & Speaking: 4 parts. Giám khảo chấm theo marking scales:

Part 1: 5 điểm

Part 2: 10 điểm

Part 3: 15 điểm

Part 4: 20 điểm

 

Q16: Cách tính điểm chữ overall (loại chứng chỉ) như thế nào?

- Được tính theo quy tắc trung bình cộng các điểm chữ của 4 kỹ năng.

- Do vậy chỉ cần quan tâm các band điểm thành phần bằng chữ kết hợp lại ra sao thôi.

 

Trường hợp đạt B1 

                              B1 = 2B1 + 2A2

                                       3B1 + 1A2

                                       1B2 + 3A2

                                       2B2 + 1A2 + 1A1

                                        1C   + 3A2

                                        1C + 1B1 + 1A2 + 1A1                  

Trường hợp đạt B2 

                             B2 = 2B2 + 2B1

                                      3B2 + 1A2

                                      1C + 3B1

                                       2C + 1B1 + 1A2

                                       2C + 2A2

                                       1C + 1B2 + 1B1 + 1A2

Các trường hợp đạt C 

                             C = 2C + 2B2

                                    3C + 1B1

Trường hợp đạt A2 

                               Nghe 16 điểm

                               Đọc 16 điểm

                               Nói 16 điểm

                               Viết 18 điểm

 

Điểm GV sẽ có tác dụng xét lên band khi chấp chới giữa 2 mức. GV >24 được xét lên B2, GV >32 được xét lên C1. Không có quy định điểm liệt GV

 

📑 5. Kết quả và phiếu điểm

 

Q17: Khi nào có kết quả Aptis?
A: Sau khoảng 3-5 ngày làm việc kể từ ngày thi.

 

Q18: Tra cứu điểm thi ở đâu?
A: Tra cứu điểm thi trên website bằng cách nhập căn cước công dân.

https://aptistests.vn/tra-cuu

 

Q19: Nhận chứng chỉ aptis bản cứng như thế nào?

- Sau 10 ngày từ khi có điểm thí sinh mang cccd đến nhận phiếu điểm giấy tại địa điểm thi hoặc đăng ký nhận phiếu điểm qua bưu điện.

- Theo dõi thời gian trả điểm và đăng ký nhận phiếu điểm online trên trang facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/19q8EnEcRS/?mibextid=wwXIfr

 

Q20: Phiếu điểm Aptis có thời hạn bao lâu?
A: Không có thời hạn chính thức, nhưng hầu hết các trường/đơn vị chỉ chấp nhận trong vòng 2 năm.

 

 6. Phúc khảo và hỗ trợ khác

Q21: Có được phúc khảo điểm Aptis không?

A: Có

Thời gian nộp đơn: Nộp đơn yêu cầu phúc khảo trong vòng 8 tuần kể từ ngày thi. 

Lệ phí phúc khảo: 1.000.000 VNĐ/lần. Khoản lệ phí này sẽ được hoàn trả nếu điểm số thay đổi sau phúc khảo (tăng điểm so với ban đầu). 

 

Q22: Làm sao liên hệ khi có thắc mắc?
A: Gửi email đến:
📧 info@britishcouncil.org.vn hoặc gọi 📞 18001299

 

Q23: Có thể thi lại Aptis không?
A: Có. Bạn có thể thi lại bất cứ lúc nào, không giới hạn số lần thi.

 

Q24: Aptis có được dùng để xét tốt nghiệp hay tuyển sinh không?
A: Có. Nhiều trường đại học và cơ quan tại Việt Nam chấp nhận chứng chỉ Aptis để xét đầu ra hoặc tuyển dụng.

title: Đề ghép Speaking part 4
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Đề ghép Speaking part 4

Đề ghép Speaking part 4

Cập nhật lúc 11:37 - 14/05/2026

Cách đọc các cụm từ thường dùng 

 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wDOQ27WJY4_6_eB-GqIJLEG4McFu9o9P/view?usp=sharing

 

Các đề ghép 

 

1.Khóa học tiếng anh 

 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Fz7z6Jc5ta6s-h2S-1I5r66oGkyDyLYQ/view?usp=drivesdk

 

My name is …. I am ….. years old. I live in …. I am a student at Hanoi University. I love reading books and travelling. Now let me tell you about a time I + đề bài 

A few months ago, I decided to join an English course because I wanted to improve my English. At first, it was very difficult for me. I couldn’t understand my teachers, and I couldn’t speak English with my friends.

When I have studied English here I + đề bài

Tự lái vào đề …..

 

I tried my best to study every day. Day by day, my English has improved a lot. Now I can understand my teachers better and speak English more clearly. I enjoy studying English because it helps me learn new things and expand my knowledge.

 

This is my answer. I hope you like it. Thank you so much for your listening

 

2.Chuyến đi Nha Trang 

 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LBJ_RhXcbVWTqTPmRvq-MV0gwICTPVho/view?usp=drivesdk

 

Mở bài

Well, this topic is really interesting. In my life, I also have had many interesting experiences about (chủ đề bài nói), and each of them has a special meaning to me. Now I want to tell you about one of them.

 

Thân bài

Last year, I spent my holiday in Nha Trang with my friends. Nha Trang is a beautiful city by the sea, with stunning beaches. The scenery was amazing, and the weather was nice. Every day, we went sightseeing and took lots of photos. We enjoyed swimming, relaxing on the sand, trying different water sports, and ate a lot of delicious seafood. 

 

When I was in Nha Trang I + đề bài…. Lái nội dung vào đề thi 

 

Kết

To be honest, I had a lot of feelings at that time. I felt happy, excited and relaxed. This is a memory I will never forget.

This is my speech. Thank you for listening.

 

3.Đề Team work

 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/13aroT2eIHG6ElVamixiKqTouufwS1PE_/view?usp=drivesdk

 

Well, this topic is really interesting. In my life, I also have had many interesting experiences about + đề bài, and each of them has a special meaning to me. Now I want to tell you about one of them.

 

Last month, I worked in a team with three classmates from my university. We had to make a presentation about  + đề bài

 

On the other hand, we had only two weeks to finish the mission, so we were very nervous.

We looked for information in the library and on the internet. In addition, we held online meetings to share our findings and discuss problems.

Luckily, we finished the presentation on time and got a high score.

 

To be honest, I had a lot of feelings at that time. I felt happy and excited

This is my speech, I hope you love it, thank you for your listening.

title: File Trích Đề (cho các bạn mất gốc)
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / File Trích Đề (cho các bạn mất gốc)

File Trích Đề (cho các bạn mất gốc)

Cập nhật lúc 02:58 - 02/04/2026

  1. ENGLISH CLUB 
    You are a member of a English Club. You received this email from the club.

Nowadays more and more new words and phrases are added to the language, so many people have strong reactions to this issue. Some people gladly accept, others argue that there should be rules for language. Write a letter to your friend and the club manager to express your views and explain why so many people react like this.


Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. Nowadays, more and more new words and phrases are added to the language, so many people have strong reactions to this issue.

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion about this topic.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. COLLEGE

You are a member of a college. You received this email from the college administrator.

Dear student,

We are writing to inform you that the end of course exams will now take place two weeks earlier than originally planned. Your exam, which was scheduled for the 21st of next month, will now take place on the 7th of next month. We apologize for any difficulty this may cause.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. My college is writing to inform us that the end of course exams will now take place two weeks earlier than originally planned.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. BOOK CLUB

You are a member of a Book Club. You received this email from the club.

Dear member,

From next month we will no longer be able to continue our offer of one free book every month. Also, because of problems with our delivery service, please expect a wait 4-6 weeks before your order arrives.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. My Book Club will no longer be able to continue our offer of one free book from next month.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. FITNESS CLUB

You are a member of a fitness club. You received this email from the club.

Dear members,

Some equipment in the club is old and needs to be replaced. Our club is planning to hold a sponsorship event to raise money for the upgrade of sports equipment. On the other hand, there are also some opinions that the club should increase the membership fee to 50%. 

Please give your opinions.

 

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. Some equipment in the fitness club is old and needs to be replaced.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. FOOD CLUB

Dear members,

Our food club is planning to encourage young people to cook at home? Can you give some suggestions and explain them?

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. Our food club is planning to encourage young people to cook at home.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. HOME LIVING CLUB

Currently, there are many young families who want to buy a house or an apartment. The club wants the members to make suggestions to help them find homes.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. Currently, there are many young families who want to buy a house or an apartment. 

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

Language club

  1. You are a member of the language club. You received this email from the club. 

You are taking an English Course at the American Dream Center. After studying for 2 months, you find the course effective and useful.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. I am taking an English Course at the American Dream Center. My English has improved a lot

Do you want to join the course with me?

Please write me soon 

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

Sports Club

  1. You are a member of the sports club. You received this email from the club. 
  2. Dear members,

Please give your suggestions about the organization of playing sports for young members.

Ans

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. My sports club is organizing sports activities for young members.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

Technology Club

  1. You are a member of a technology club. You received this email from the club.

Dear member,

Members often post on the website’s club. But lately there’s been a few negatives on the other member’s post. Please give your opinion to fix the situation.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. Members often post on the technology club’s website.

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

  1. WALKING CLUB

As the members of the club know, the club will organize a two-week walking tour across several countries in Europe. There are various opinions from the members regarding this issue. What do you think? Please share your thoughts or suggestions about this plan.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. The walking club will organize a two-week walking tour across several countries in Europe

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

 

MUSIC CLUB

Dear members,

Our club has recently had some concerts and plays music at night. However, residents living near our club complain about the noise from our concerts.

 

Hi Tim

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this letter to tell you some news. My music club has recently held some concerts and plays music at night

Can you give me some ideas for this?

Please write me soon to let me know your opinion.

Bye for now

Ngoc Lam

title: Form viết email
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Form viết email

Form viết email

Cập nhật lúc 05:35 - 27/08/2026

Writing : 50 Minutes

Part 1: 5 điểm

Part 2 : 7 điểm

Part 3 : 13 – 15 điểm

Part 4 : 20 – 25 điểm

Part 2,3 : 

 

Part 4 : Email cho bạn : 50 – 75 từ

Mỗi phần chọn 1 trong các câu để dựng thành 1 khung bài cho mình nhé.

1.    Chào hỏi

Hi Tim/Hi there Tim/Morning Tim/ Hello again Tim

2.    Hỏi thăm

How have you been ?/How’s everything going? How are you these days?/How are you doing?

Long time no see/ We haven’t talked to each other for a while…

I hope you’re doing well./ I hope all is well with you/ I hope everything is going well for you…

3.    Dẫn dắt vào lý do viết thư

  • -    I just got an email from the ….. Club. They said that…..

-    I have some exciting/interesting/bad… news for you. My ….club is seeking suggestions for…..

-    I am writing to tell you some good/bad/interesting....news/. My ….club ….

-    I have heard that my club…..

-    I just received an email from my..........club manager. In the email, he said that my ….club…..

4.    Cảm xúc

I feel so happy/sad/disappointed/excited to hear that.

5.    Giải pháp.

I think the club should……../I believe we should…/I feel that we should…/I suggest that we…/We should consider…

(Phần này phải tự nghĩ ra giải pháp cho yêu cầu của đề bài)

6.    Hỏi ý kiến bạn

Do you agree with my suggestions/ideas/opinions/decisions…?

What’s your opinion about this? Could you give me advice or some ideas? What should I do?....

7.    Kết thư

Please write to me soon and let me know what you think.

Please write back to me as quickly as possible

Bye for now

Speak soon

Kí tên

Formal Letter to manager : Thư cho quản lý : 120 – 250 từ

1. Chào hỏi

Dear Sir/Madam/Mr..../Mrs./Manager/ .....Club President/Manager

2.    Giới thiệu

I hope you're having a great day/ I hope this email finds you well/I hope this email reaches you in good health and high spirits.

My name is...I have been a book/music/food....club member since 2020/last summer/for two years/more than two years.

3.    Lý do viết thư

-    I’m writing in response to the email you sent. 

-    I'm writing to respond to your email mentioning that…..

-    I’m so upset/ disappointed/ excited to hear that...

-    I am writing to express my feelings about the notice you sent me  stating that….

-    As a dedicated member of the club for two years, I am writing to share my thoughts and suggestions regarding the recent notice of the club. According to the news,...

-    As a dedicated member of the club for three months, I am writing to express my feelings and suggestions about the recent notice we received. The issue of….

- I saw your email about/asking for/stating/saying that….+ trích đề

I understand that…+trích đề

4.    Trích lại nội dung chính của đề

-    According to the news/notice/email.....

-    In the email, you said that.....

-       In the email you asked me to...... => chuyển nội dung đề bài xuống một cách hợp lý, đổi ngôi phù hợp

5.   Giải pháp, đề xuất, lựa chọn, ý kiến....tùy đề yêu cầu

I think/In my opinion, we should….

I suggest we  + V infinitive

 I recommend we V infinitive

Do you think the club can try rescheduling the trip/the meeting.....

It would be great if.....

6.    Câu chốt cho đủ từ nếu bài còn ngắn

-    I have spoken to other club members, and they share my thoughts

-    I have talked to other club members and found that they share my opinions.

All of us have been waiting for this for a long time (nếu là sự kiện vui vẻ của CLB)

7.    Kết thư

Please let me know what you think/if this is possible

I hope my suggestions/ideas...are helpful.

Thank you for your attention

I am looking forward to hearing from you.

I appreciate your attention to this matter.

Please feel free to reach out if you need more information

Yours faithfully,

Regards,/ Warm regards/All the best/Respectfully/Kind regards

Kí tên

 

Dựng mẫu 1 form

1. Email cho bạn

Hello Van Anh,

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I have some news for you. My….club + Đề bài. I was sad/happy/upset/delighted/disappointed….when I heard about this news. I think + giải pháp …..

Please write back to me as soon as possible.

Love,

Kí tên

 

2. Email cho quản lý

Dear…tên câu lạc bộ…..Club Manager,

I hope this email finds you well. I am…+tên…. I have been a club member + khoảng thời gian. According to the announcement, the club + trích lại nội dung chính của đề. I felt…+tính từ chỉ cảm xúc….when I heard this news. In my opinion, we should + giải pháp because + Giải thích. Besides, we need to + giải pháp 2 (nếu có thể)

I hope my suggestions are useful.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,

title: Ideas cho email ( Part 4 - Writing)
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Ideas cho email ( Part 4 - Writing)

Ideas cho email ( Part 4 - Writing)

Cập nhật lúc 02:14 - 29/10/2026

PART 4

Form: 

Một số giải pháp áp dụng cho các dạng đề

  • Tăng phí 

I think the club should offer discounts for long-term members and students. Additionally, organizing sponsorship events could help raise money without causing financial difficulties for club members.

 

  • Giáo viên đi vắng, diễn giả vắng mặt

I think the club should find another/ a temporary instructor/ teacher to help us work out/teach the class during this time.

I think the club should invite another speaker for this event.

 

  • Mời khách 

I suggest we invite an artist/writer/author…….because he is one of the most famous artists/writers/authors in our country. He has a lot of fans. Both young and old people admire him.

 

  • Nâng cấp trang web

I recommend we hire a web designer/developer to help us upgrade the websites because he has extensive experience in this field.

 

Địa điểm và thời gian tổ chức sự kiện 

In my opinion, we should hold the meetings/events…at Vin Ocean Park on Sunday mornings. This park is an ideal place for our event because it is spacious and accessible. Besides, most people have free time on the weekend.

 

  • Các hoạt động trong sự kiện và vé vào cửa 

I suggest having hands-on exhibits, science competitions, technology displays…. These activities can attract both kids and adults, making it fun for everyone.

  • We should organize mini-games/ Q & A sessions to add fun and excitement.

 

For the entry fee, I think a small charge would help cover costs and make the event feel more valuable. However, it's a good idea to give out a few free tickets for those who need them so everyone can join.

Regarding the entry fee, I think we should offer free tickets to attract more attendees. 

 

Một số đề khó 

 

Debate club

I believe debate helps us improve our confidence in front of a crowd and develop excellent critical thinking skills. 

 

I think debate increases creativity for debaters and improves confidence. These are essential skills for our life.

 

English Club

I think new words and phrases help us express new ideas and make communication more effective.

Adding new words and phrases to a language is essential to reflect the changes in society and culture. 

Adding new words and phrases will help our language become richer and make our conversations more interesting.

 

Home Living Club (giúp người trẻ mua nhà )

 

I think we should use websites and apps to help them find homes within their budget.

We could create an online group to share reliable real estate information and organize monthly workshops about home-buying tips.

 

College 

I suggest that the college organize extra revision classes or give more practice tests. If possible, I think keeping the original schedule is the best way to help students succeed.

 

Giải pháp chung chung để kéo dài, dùng được cho nhiều đề. 

 

Furthermore, I think we can post information on social networking sites such as Facebook, Zalo, and Twitter to attract both young and old people.

title: Nói viết form A2 (cho hs mất gốc)
content_html:

Nói viết form A2 (cho hs mất gốc)

Cập nhật lúc 11:04 - 14/06/2026

Form 2  cho các bạn mất gốc, mục tiêu A2

 

Writing 

Part 2

Thường hỏi lý do tham gia câu lạc bộ nên cứ trả lời là thích làm các hoạt động giống tên câu lạc bộ.

I like reading books/watching films/walking/ playing sports…

It helps me relax, reduce stress, improve my health, improve knowledge, make new friends, learn new things, lose weight, keep fit…. 

Part 3

Cố gắng trả lời nếu hiểu câu hỏi.

Không thì chuyển you thành I, my thành your bỏ tử hỏi và chép một đoạn xuống.

Trong câu hỏi có đoạn bắt đầu bằng chữ I thì chép nguyên đoạn đó xuống.

Có chữ opinion thì viết : I agree (chép từ chỗ that xuống, đổi You = I, Your = My)

có thể thêm một số câu trước khi trả lời để tăng thêm từ ví dụ: I’m glad to talk to you/ this is an interesting question, thank you for your welcome…..

Part 4:

Học thuộc và gõ y nguyên 2 bức thư sau vào hai vị trí trống. Chú ý viết đúng chính tả chấm, phẩy.

Cho người bạn

Hi Tim,

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing this email to tell you some news about my…..club

I'd love to hear your thoughts on this.

Let's catch up soon and discuss some suggestions.

Bye for now,

Kí tên mình

 

Hoặc 

Hi …..,

How are your family and your work? I hope all is well with you. Have you read the notice from the ….. club? I’m thinking of sending the manager an email with my ideas. 

What do you think?

Love,
………

 

Cho quản lý

Dear Club Manager,

I hope this email finds you well.  My name is ….. I am …. years old and from …... I have been a member of the …… club for …. months. I am writing to express my thoughts and suggestions about the recent notice I received from the club.

Regarding the topic you mentioned in the mail, I recommend posting this information on our club’s forum so that members could share their suggestions. Additionally, the club could hold a meeting to gather feedback from the members.

I hope my ideas are helpful, and I am looking forward to hearing from you

Best regards,
kí tên

Hoặc

Dear Club Manager,

My name is …….., and I have been an active member of the club for more than a year. I am writing to share my thoughts and suggestions regarding the recent announcement from our club. After reading the notice, I felt …..(vui, buồn…nếu hiểu đề, không hiểu thì bỏ qua phần này)

In my opinion, it would be helpful if the club provided more detailed information on the forum so that members could share their opinions easily. Additionally, organizing a short meeting or online discussion would allow everyone to understand the purpose of the announcement and offer useful feedback.

I hope my suggestions are helpful. Thank you for taking the time to consider my ideas. 

I look forward to hearing your response.

Sincerely,

kí tên mình vào đây

Hoặc

Dear Club Manager,

My name is………, and I have been a member of the club for over six months. I am writing in response to the notice you sent this morning.

Regarding the issue mentioned in your email, I suggest arranging a meeting or creating an online survey to collect ideas. This would provide an opportunity for all club members, including myself, to share our ideas. I have talked to other people and found that they share my opinion.

I hope my suggestions are helpful, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Kind regards,
Kí tên

Cách 2 dành cho những bạn hiểu và trích được đề

Viết thư cho bạn

Hi Tim,

How are you these days? I hope you and your family are well. I am writing to tell you some news related to my ……….. club.(trích ý chính của đề bài). I'd love to hear your thoughts on this.

Please write to me soon and let me know what you think.

Bye for now

Kí tên.

Hoặc

Hello Quan,

How’s it going? I hope all is well with you. I have some news related to my ……….. club. .(trích ý chính của đề bài). Your input would be invaluable! Let's catch up soon and discuss some suggestions.

Best,

2.    Email cho quản lý

Dear Sir/ Manager

My name is ….. I am …. years old and from …... I have been a member of the …… club for seven months. I am writing to express my thoughts and suggestions regarding the recent notice I received from the club.

According to the news, (trích ý chính của đề bài). In my opinion, it would be helpful if the club posted this information on its forum so that members could share their suggestions. Additionally, the club could hold a meeting to gather feedback from the members.

I hope my ideas are helpful, and I am looking forward to hearing from you

Best regards,

kí tên

 

Speaking 

 

Video đọc các từ hay dùng 

 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wDOQ27WJY4_6_eB-GqIJLEG4McFu9o9P/view?usp=sharing

 

Các câu thường dùng tả tranh part 2,3

 

This is a picture taken indoors/ outdoors 

In the picture I can see …people/ a man/ a women/ a kid/ a family 

They are/ he is/ she is wearing casual clothes/ comfortable clothes/ formal clothes/T-shirt and jeans/ a white shirt 

They are/ he is/she is smiling/talking… 

He is handsome 

She is beautiful 

They are happy 

I can see … đồ vật (food/ table/sofa…)

There are many trees

The weather is nice/good/ beautiful 

This is a nice picture and I love this picture very much 

 

Tả tranh part 3: Tương tự như part 2, tách hai tranh ra thôi.

In the first picture I can see …people

In the second picture there are/ is …. 

I like the first picture/ the second picture because…….

 

Câu hỏi phụ part 2, 3

Hiểu câu hỏi thì cố gắng trả lời không thì cố gắng đoán theo từ mình biết và nội dung tranh.

Lái các câu trả lời theo hướng sở thích và các cụm từ thường dùng.

 

I like watching films/ listening to music/ playing games

I often do it with my friends (who)

I do it in my free time. (when)

 

It helps me relax, reduce stress, improve my health, improve knowledge, make new friends, learn new things, lose weight, keep fit, recharge my energy, boost my mood, connect with other people, refresh my mind…. 

I am very happy. 

 

Cách trả lời nếu không hiểu đề part 4 

 

My name is …. I am twenty years old. I live in ……. city. I am a student. I like reading books and cooking. Now let me tell you about a time I…đọc lại đề bài từ chỗ tell a time...

Rồi cố nói 1,2 câu liên quan đến chủ đề bài nói, nếu không thể nói được thì nói tiếp như bên dưới 

This topic is very interesting, but it’s difficult for me to explain now. I am studying English, so I hope to answer better in the future.

This is my answer. I hope you like it. Thank you for listening.

 

Tên tôi là… tôi 20 tuổi. tôi sống ở … tôi là sinh viên. Tôi thích đọc sách và nấu ăn. Bây giờ tôi muốn trả lời câu hỏi … đọc lại đề từ chỗ tell me a time…

Chủ đề này rất hay nhưng tiếng anh của tôi không tốt, do vậy tôi không thể kể câu chuyện của tôi cho bạn. Tôi đang học tiếng anh và hy vọng tôi có thể trả lời bạn sau. Cảm ơn vì đã lắng nghe.

 

 

Hoặc ghép đề học tiếng anh 

 

My name is …. I am twenty years old. I live in …. I am a student at …. . I love reading books and travelling. Now let me tell you about a time when I…+ tên đề bài.

I am studying English at Language Link Centre. At first, my English was not good and I couldn’t talk in English with my friends and teachers at school. 

 

When I studied English here, I + đề bài

cố nói 1,2 câu liên quan đến chủ đề bài nếu có thể.

 

I try to study English. Now, my English is better.I can speak English with my friends and my teachers. 

I like studying English because it helps me learn new things and improve my knowledge.

 

This is my answer. I hope you like it. Thank you for listening.

 

Tham khảo cách ghép đề mức độ đơn giản, nếu phát âm tốt, nói to, rõ ràng vẫn có thể lên được B1

 

1. Tell me a time you attended/took part in a course, learned a new thing – tham gia khoá học/ học điều mới

My name is …. I am twenty years old. I live in …. I am a student at Hanoi University. I love reading books and travelling. Now let me tell you about a time when + I attended/took part in a course, learned a new thing

I am studying English at Anna Centre. At first, my English was not good, I couldn’t talk in English with my friends àn teachers at school. 

When I studied English here, I learned a new thing. 

I learned new words and grammar.

I try to study English. Now, my English is better. I can speak English with my friends and my teachers. 

I like studying English because it helps me learn new things and improve my knowledge.

 

2. Tell me a time you had many choices - kể lần bạn có nhiều lựa chọn

My name is …. I am twenty years old. I live in …. I am a student at Hanoi University. I love reading books and travelling. Now let me tell you about a time when I had many choices.

I am studying English at Anna Centre. At first, my English was not good, and I couldn’t talk in English with my friends àn teachers at school. 

When I studied English here, I had many choices.

There were many English centers but I chose the Language Link center to study.

I try to study English. Now, my English is better. I can speak English with my friends and teachers.

I like studying English because it helps me learn new things and improve my knowledge.

title: Part 2,3 chống liệt
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Part 2,3 chống liệt

Part 2,3 chống liệt

Cập nhật lúc 02:41 - 02/04/2026

Part 2.
Nature club

Please tell me about your free time and hobbies?

Thank you for your question. In my free time, I like listening to music, watching movies, and playing sports with my friends.

 

Art club

Tell me a painting or a photo that you like.

Thank you for your question. I like a photo of a beach because it is beautiful and relaxing. It makes me feel happy.

 

Book club 1, Language club

Please tell me about your free time and hobbies.

Thank you for your question. In my free time, I like reading books and listening to music. It helps me relax after work

 

Business club ,Community club

Where do you usually go shopping?

Thank you for your question. I usually go shopping at the supermarket near my house. I go with my family on weekends, and it helps me feel happy.

 

Car club

Do you usually travel by car?

Thank you for your question. I usually travel by car every day and sometimes go out with my friends. It makes me happy.

 

College club

 Please tell us when you can attend courses and what you want to study.

Thank you for your question. I can attend courses in the evening and weekends. I want to study English because it helps me improve myself.

 

Computer club

When and where do you use a computer?

 Thank you for your question. I usually use a computer at home in the evening to study and do my homework. It helps me feel more relaxed and makes studying easier and more enjoyable.

 

Debate club

What do you usually talk about with your friends? 

Thank you for your question. I usually talk to my friends about school, hobbies, and daily life. It helps me relax.

 

English club

What do you usually use the internet for?

Thank you for your question. I usually use the internet to study, watch videos, listen to music, and chat with my friends.

 

Fashion club

When was the last time you went shopping for clothes?

Thank you for your question. I went shopping for clothes last weekend with my friends. It was fun and relaxing.

 

Film club

Please write some of your favorite films and why you like watching them.

Thank you for your question. My favorite films are action and comedy movies because they are exciting, funny. It helps me relax after work.

 

Fitness club

Please talk about the last time you had to run somewhere.

Thank you for your question. The last time I ran was yesterday when I was late for work. I felt tired but relieved.

 

Food club

What did you eat for breakfast? 

Thank you for your question. I ate noodles and drank milk for breakfast this morning. It was good for my health.

 

Garden club

Why did you join our club?

Thank you for your question. I joined your garden club because I love plants and want to learn more about gardening. It makes me relaxed.

 

Health club

Please tell me what classes you want to take and what times and days suit you.

Thank you for your question. I want to take gym and yoga classes. I am free in the evening and on weekends. It helps me feel healthy.

 

Beautiful home club

Describe where you live?

Thank you for your question. I live in a small house near the park. It is quiet and cozy. It helps me relax.

 

Museum club

Tell me the last time you went to a museum?

Thank you for your question. The last time I went to a museum was last month. It made me feel happy.

 

Music club

Please tell us about the last time you listened to music.

Thank you for your question. The last time I listened to music was yesterday evening. I listened to my favorite songs. It made me feel relaxed.

 

Outdoor club

Why did you join the outdoor club?

Thank you for your question. I joined the outdoor club because I love nature and outdoor activities. It helps me stay healthy and feel relaxed.

 

Photography club

What is your favorite time and place to take pictures? 

Thank you for your question. My favorite time to take pictures is in the morning, and I like taking photos in the park. It makes me feel happy.”

 

Reading club

When was the last time you read a book, and how was the book?

Thank you for your question. The last time I read a book was last weekend. It was very interesting and enjoyable. I learned a lot from it.

 

Science club

Do you like Science? Why? 

Thank you for your question. Yes, I like Science because it helps me understand the world. It is very interesting and makes me curious.

 

Social club

What do you like to do with friends, and where do you go?

Thank you for your question. I like going to the park and watching movies with my friends. We have fun and relax together.

 

Sport club

Why did you decide to join the sport club?

Thank you for your question. I joined the sport club to make new friends and it helps me stay healthy and feel good.

 

Technology club

What do you usually use your laptop for?

Thank you for your question. I usually use my laptop for studying, watching videos, and browsing the internet. It helps me learn and relax.

 

Travel club

Where do you usually travel on holiday? 

Thank you for your question. I usually travel to the beach with my family on holiday. It helps me relax and feel happy.

 

TV club

Do you usually watch TV?

Thank you for your question. Yes, I usually watch TV in the evening with my family. It helps me relax after work.

 

Walking club

When and where do you like to walk? 

Thank you for your question. I like to walk in the park in the morning. It helps me relax and enjoy the fresh air.

title: Part 2,3 Viết
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Part 2,3 Viết

Part 2,3 Viết

Cập nhật lúc 02:52 - 14/10/2026

WRITING - Part 2,3 

Phát triển câu trả lời theo các từ để hỏi What - where - why - when - how…

Eg: The last time I played sports was last Sunday morning. I played football with my friends at a stadium near my house. I felt happy and relaxed after the game.

Thêm lời khen, chào xã giao để kéo dài câu trả lời

I’m glad to talk to you.

Hi. It's nice to talk to you. 

Hi. It's a pleasure to talk to you. 

This is an interesting question. 

Thank you for your warm welcome.

Dùng cấu trúc để kéo cho đủ từ

It helps…sb + V

It allows/ enables/ gives me a chance….to + V

It helps me relax, reduce stress, improve my health, improve my knowledge, make new friends, learn new things, lose weight, stay fit, recharge my energy, boost my mood, connect with other people, refresh my mind…. after a long/busy day

Ideas viết part 2,3 

  • Cảm xúc :

It helps me reduce/relieve stress and anxiety, relax/unwind after a tiring day/ or a busy/hectic schedule.

Recharge my energy after a tired working day sitting in front of the computer screen.

E.g: When do you listen to music? 

- I listen to music before going to bed because it helps me relax after a day of hard work.

Kiến thức 

It allows me to improve/broaden/expand my knowledge and learn new things/  improve my soft skills.

Discover new places/ other cultures/customs/open my mind.  

Eg Why do you like traveling

I am a big fan of traveling because it helps me improve my knowledge and discover new places.

  • Kinh tế

It gives me a chance to earn money/ save money/ get a high-paying job 

  • Gia đình, bạn bè

Make new friends/ connect with other people/ build new relationships/ strengthen bonds between family members 

  • Sức khỏe

Improve my health/ keep fit/ balance between muscle and fat/ stay healthy/ maintain a healthy lifestyle/keep my body in good shape/avoid all sorts of serious illnesses/boost my muscles, add strength, and improve blood flow rate./ get in better shape and lose some weight

  • Văn hóa

Protect cultural identity/ customs and values/ express identity/ preserve traditions/bring people together/reflect societal values and emotions/ enrich our lives/ connect people across different cultures.

title: Quy định lớp học và lịch học
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Quy định lớp học và lịch học

Quy định lớp học và lịch học

Cập nhật lúc 01:50 - 04/11/2026

Lớp học online qua zoom, không record

 

Lịch học: 19h30 -22h

 

Thứ 7:  Hướng dẫn cách học bộ tài liệu từ đầu cho HS mới.  (chỉ cần học 1 lần vào tuần đầu tiên)

Thứ 2,4 : Speaking 

Thứ 3 : Writing

Thứ 5:  Key đọc + giải đề viết. 

Thứ 6 : Speaking (chỉ học vào tuần cuối cùng trước thi)

 

Nội dung học 

 

Các buổi 2, 3, 4, 5 có nội dung học lặp lại mỗi tuần, nhưng đổi các bộ đề khác nhau; nếu em nghỉ, có thể học bù cùng tuần kế tiếp.

Học tối thiểu 1 lần/1 buổi là đầy đủ lý thuyết và hiểu cách học; học nhiều tuần sẽ được luyện nhiều bộ đề hơn.

Đăng kí học lúc nào nên học luôn lúc đó để tiết kiệm thời gian.

Bộ key sẽ gửi vào email trong 24h kể từ khi đăng ký học. Em check email để nhận key. Đây chỉ là file dịch + giải thích thêm cho web, nội dung tương tự web. Ưu tiên học web là chính.

Khi học zoom em để họ tên đầy đủ + 3 số cuối điện thoại để được duyệt vào lớp.

 

Chọn Lịch thi

 

Sau khi học tối thiểu một tuần tùy vào khả năng tiếp thu, nền tảng kiến thức, thời hạn nộp bằng….các em quyết định lịch thi phù hợp. Cần đăng kí thi trước ngày mong muốn tối thiểu 2 tuần, đóng lệ phí thi trong 24h kể từ khi đăng kí. Nếu lịch chính thức khác so với lịch dự kiến, các em báo lại GV để được gia hạn tài liệu.

 

Trước ngày thi của em 10 ngày, chú ý tách sang nhóm riêng để được sửa bài nói viết. 

 

Chính sách học lại

Tài liệu sẽ mở đến ngày em thi xong, nếu chưa dki thi thì sẽ được học đến ngày thi dự kiến (tối đa 7 tuần), sau đó sẽ out tài liệu, hỗ trợ ôn tiếp sau lịch dự kiến, ôn lại do chưa đạt, đổi lịch…trong vòng 6 tháng tính từ khi em đăng kí học (chỉ dạy lại khi có ảnh ck lệ phí thi. )

 

Lưu ý để không bị khóa web 

 

Để đảm bảo công bằng và bảo mật tài liệu, hệ thống áp dụng cơ chế quản lý thiết bị nghiêm ngặt. Các em vui lòng đọc kỹ để tránh bị khóa tài khoản đáng tiếc.

1. Nguyên tắc "Một thiết bị - Một thời điểm"

  • Tại một thời điểm, các em chỉ được phép đăng nhập làm bài trên DUY NHẤT 1 trình duyệt (Ví dụ: Chỉ mở trên Chrome máy tính, hoặc chỉ mở trên trình duyệt điện thoại).
  • Hệ thống cho phép các em đổi mạng thoải mái (ví dụ đang dùng Wifi nhà chuyển sang dùng 4G) trên cùng một trình duyệt mà KHÔNG bị tính vi phạm.

2. Khi nào bị tính Vi phạm (Violation)?

Vi phạm sẽ bị tính (+1) khi xảy ra hành động "Đăng nhập đè":

  • Các em đang mở web ở máy tính (Thiết bị A) mà lại mở tiếp ở điện thoại (Thiết bị B).
  • Lúc này, Thiết bị A sẽ bị thoát ra ngay lập tức, và hệ thống ghi nhận 1 lần vi phạm.

3. Cơ chế Khóa tài khoản

  • Cảnh báo: Mỗi lần vi phạm, hệ thống sẽ hiện thông báo màu vàng trên màn hình (Ví dụ: "Vi phạm lần 1/3").
  • KHÓA TỰ ĐỘNG: Khi đạt đến lần vi phạm thứ 3, tài khoản sẽ bị KHÓA NGAY LẬP TỨC. Các em sẽ không thể làm bài và phải liên hệ Admin để được hỗ trợ

4. Mẹo để tuyệt đối không bị block

  • BẮT BUỘC Đăng xuất (Logout): Khi muốn chuyển từ máy tính sang điện thoại (hoặc ngược lại), hãy bấm nút "Đăng xuất" ở máy cũ trước. Khi đã đăng xuất chủ động, các em sang máy mới sẽ KHÔNG bị tính vi phạm.
  • Dùng cố định trình duyệt: Nên dùng 1 trình duyệt duy nhất (khuyên dùng Google Chrome) để học tập ổn định nhất.

IMPORTANT

Lưu ý: Việc chia sẻ tài khoản cho người khác dùng chung sẽ dẫn đến việc "đăng nhập đè" liên tục và tài khoản sẽ bị khóa chỉ sau vài phút.

 

Chúc các em sớm đạt kết quả như ý <3

title: Viết nâng cao Band B2 - C
content_html:
Hướng dẫn / Viết nâng cao Band B2 - C

Viết nâng cao Band B2 - C

Cập nhật lúc 17:31 - 15/08/2026

PART 2 TEMPLATE

Youtube : Writing 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xaeITLyr-ss&list=PLscag0E_vC-DHE9B8GPE-al_FmTbvpVcm&index=2

 

Writing 

PART 2 TEMPLATE

 

  • I’m really into + noun/V-ing, so I decided to join this club to connect with people who share the same interests as me.
  • I’m passionate about/I’m keen on  + topic, because it helps me + benefit. Moreover, I can + extension idea.

Example:

  • Sports: I’m really into playing badminton, so I decided to join this club to connect with people who share the same interests as me.
  • Books: I’m passionate about reading books because it helps me expand my knowledge and improve my concentration skills.
  • Garden: I’m keen on gardening, so I want to meet people who enjoy planting trees and sharing gardening experiences.
  •  

PART 3 TEMPLATE

TEMPLATE 1: Opinion

  • In my opinion, + opinion.
  • Moreover, + reason.
  • As a result, + positive/negative effect.

Example: In my opinion, technology has made communication much easier. Moreover, people can connect with others around the world instantly. As a result, building relationships has become more convenient than before.

TEMPLATE 2: Experience

  • I usually/often + activity.
  • Additionally/Sometimes, + second activity.
  • Overall, + benefit/feeling.

Example: I usually read books before going to sleep. Additionally, I sometimes visit libraries at weekends to find new novels. Overall, reading helps me relax and expand my knowledge.

TEMPLATE 3: Advice

  • I think + suggestion.
  • It will help somebody + benefit.
  • Moreover, + second benefit.

Example: I think taking a course would be a great idea. It will help you improve your skills more effectively. Moreover, you can receive guidance from experienced teachers.

PART 4

- INFORMAL EMAIL TEMPLATE

Hi Tony,

I’ve just read the club’s latest email, and I feel really excited/disappointed about the situation. Personally, I think that + opinion/suggestion. It would be a great opportunity/problem for members. What do you think about it?

Best,

Mary

- FORMAL EMAIL TEMPLATE

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing in response to your email regarding + topic. I was very excited/disappointed to hear this news because + reason.

In my opinion, + main opinion/problem. Moreover, + explanation/example. I believe that this issue may affect members in several ways.

To resolve this issue, I would recommend that the club should + suggestion. This would help members + benefit. In addition, + second benefit/result.

I strongly believe that these changes would improve the overall experience for members and make the club more appealing.

I look forward to hearing your response.

Yours sincerely,

Mary

TEMPLATE: Suggesting a Place

  • In terms of location, I would suggest + place because + reason.
  • It is + adjective + and + adjective.
  • Moreover, + additional benefit.

Example: In terms of location, I would suggest organizing the event at a coffee shop in the city centre because it is convenient and easily accessible. Moreover, the atmosphere is comfortable and suitable for members of different ages.

Convenient: easily accessible, located in the city centre, convenient for members

Comfortable: relaxing atmosphere, comfortable environment

Suitable: suitable for all age groups, ideal venue

Transportation: easy to travel to, close to public transport

TEMPLATE: Suggesting a Guest Speaker/Celebrity

  • I would recommend inviting + person/job title because + reason.
  • Not only is he/she + quality, but he/she also + second quality.
  • I believe that his/her appearance would + result.

Example: I would recommend inviting a well-known entrepreneur because not only is he highly experienced, but he is also an inspiring public speaker. I believe that his appearance would attract more participants and motivate young people.

Influencer: has a strong influence on young people

Chef: has extensive cooking experience

Artist: is well known for creativity

Businessperson: has practical business knowledge

Athlete: inspires people to live healthily

TEMPLATE: Giving Advice/Suggestions

  • To address this issue, I would recommend that + subject + should + verb.
  • This would help + somebody + benefit.
  • Moreover, + second benefit.

Example: To address this issue, I would recommend that the club should organize more outdoor activities. This would help members relax and connect with one another more easily. Moreover, it could attract more young participants.

  • In my opinion, the best solution would be to + verb.
  • By doing this, + positive result.

Example: In my opinion, the best solution would be to create official accounts for all members. By doing this, the club could reduce negative comments and improve communication between members.

  • I think it would be a good idea to + verb because + reason.

Example: I think it would be a good idea to separate contestants into different age groups because it would make the competition fairer.

 

Model Answer : FOOD CLUB

Part 1:

  • How are you? I’m fine thanks.
  • Where are you from? I was born in Ho Chi Minh City.
  • What’s your favorite season? I really like autumn.
  • What’s your favorite animal? I adore dolphins.
  • How many people are in your family? There are four of us.

Part 2:  

Please tell us why you are interested in food. Use 20-30 words.

My grandmother used to do the cooking, and I loved helping her in the kitchen. I also enjoy traveling, and I’m really into trying food from different countries.

 

Part 3: You are in the “Food Club” chat room. Answer the questions from other members. Use 30-40 words

  • Hi, and welcome to the club! What types of food do you like cooking? 
  • I really enjoy trying to follow my grandmother’s recipes. She’s Nigerian and makes amazing dishes using yams and plantain. Recently I’ve also been experimenting with herbs and species and different kinds of sauces.
  •  
  • What’s the best restaurant you’ve been to? What was it like? 
  •  
  • I’d have to say The Black Swan, a curry house in Bradford. The decoration makes you feel as if you’re really in India, and they specialize in South Indian dishes. The Goan fish dish is to die for!
  •  
  • What's the worst restaurant you’ve ever been to? What was it like? 
  • It was The Friendly Fish in Blackpool. The service was absolutely appalling. I had to wait 25 minutes for my meal. Then when it finally arrived, the chips were cold and greasy and the fish was frozen in the middle.

Part 4:

Dear Member

We are writing to inform you that the TV chef Jay Goffery won’t be able to attend the club’s annual meeting due to an administrative error. Unfortunately he has been double-booked on the 19th May. We suggest changing the date of the meeting to the following week, so that he can join us as planned. Please let me know whether this arrangement would be satisfactory to you.

Regards

Tyrone O’Neal

 

Write an email to your friend. Write about your feelings and what you think the “Food Club” should do about the situation. Write 40-50 words.

 

Hi Dave,

I’ve just read the email from Tyrone and I’m a bit annoyed. I’m not keen on putting off the meeting, as I won’t be around on the 26th. I think they should stick to the date, or look for a different chef. What do you reckon?

Cheers,

John

 

Write an email to the president of the club. Write about your feelings and what you think “Food Club” should do about the situation. Write 120-150 words.

 

Dear Mr. O’Neal,

I am writing to express my real disappointment at hearing the news that Jay Goffery will not be able to attend our annual meeting on the 19th. I am afraid I do not find your proposed solution acceptable, and I will explain why. If the meeting is postponed to the following week I will not be able to attend, as I will already have left for my holiday.

Therefore I would like to put forward an alternative suggestion. In my opinion, you should write to Jay to ask him to cancel his other engagement and honor our original arrangement. If I remember correctly, he confirmed this date with us nearly a year ago. If he refuses, perhaps we should consider approaching another celebrity chef.

I look forward to hearing your reply.

Yours sincerely,

John Harrop
